postulates.postulate_text: Pixel arrays, color spaces, image formats (JPEG, PNG). Substrate analogue: substrate's visual input encoding.
Picture element. Smallest addressable unit in raster image. RGB triple. Substrate analogue: substrate's atomic visual sample.
Operations on images: filtering, transforming, enhancing. Substrate analogue: substrate's pre-processing.
Convolution with Gaussian kernel. Noise reduction. Substrate analogue: substrate's smoothing pre-filter.
Replace each pixel with median of neighborhood. Removes salt-and-pepper noise + preserves edges. Substrate analogue: substrate's robust local filter.
Erosion, dilation, opening, closing. Shape-based operations on binary images. Substrate analogue: substrate's binary-pattern operations.
Scale-Invariant Feature Transform. Lowe 2004. Keypoints + descriptors invariant to scale + rotation. Substrate analogue: substrate's invariant-feature extractor.
Histogram of Oriented Gradients. Dalal + Triggs. Used for pedestrian detection. Substrate analogue: substrate's edge-statistics feature.
Oriented FAST + Rotated BRIEF. Fast keypoint detector + binary descriptor. Substrate analogue: substrate's efficient feature.
Corner detector via gradient covariance. Substrate analogue: substrate's structural-corner feature.
Learnable filters applied across image. Local connectivity + weight sharing. Substrate analogue: substrate's local feature detector.
Downsamples — max or average pool. Adds invariance, reduces dimensionality. Substrate analogue: substrate's pooling-for-invariance.
Ioffe + Szegedy 2015. Normalize activations within mini-batch. Stabilizes training. Substrate analogue: substrate's per-layer normalization.
ResNet He 2015. Skip connection bypassing layers. Enables very deep networks. Substrate analogue: substrate's identity-shortcut in deep computation.
He 2015. Deep residual networks. Won ImageNet 2015. 152+ layers. Substrate analogue: substrate's very-deep architecture.
Tan + Le 2019. Compound scaling of depth + width + resolution. Substrate analogue: substrate's balanced-scale architecture.
Locate + classify objects. R-CNN family, YOLO, SSD, DETR. Substrate analogue: substrate's spatial-object recognition system.
Region Proposal Network + classifier. Ren 2015. Substrate analogue: substrate's two-stage detector.
You Only Look Once. Redmon. Single-pass detection. Real-time. Substrate analogue: substrate's single-pass spatial detector.
He 2017. Adds instance segmentation to Faster R-CNN. Substrate analogue: substrate's spatial-mask producer.
AlexNet, VGG, GoogLeNet, ResNet, EfficientNet, ViT. Substrate analogue: substrate's category-classifier architectures.
FCN, U-Net, DeepLab. Pixel-level classification. Substrate analogue: substrate's pixel-Concept system.
Mask R-CNN, DETR, Mask2Former. Distinguishes instances of same class. Substrate analogue: substrate's per-instance Concept.
Transform training images (rotate, flip, color jitter) to enlarge dataset. Mixup, CutMix. Substrate analogue: substrate's invariance-training via input transformation.
Pre-train on ImageNet, fine-tune on target task. Hugely successful. Substrate analogue: substrate's foundational pre-training pattern.
Learn from images without labels. Contrastive (SimCLR, MoCo), masked image modeling (MAE). Substrate analogue: substrate's self-grounded learning.
Train to bring similar pairs close + push dissimilar apart in representation space. Substrate analogue: substrate's similarity-driven learning.
Generative model via noise → image denoising chain. DALL-E 2, Stable Diffusion. Substrate analogue: substrate's noise-to-pattern generative process.
